segments.context: Naviglio Deluxe HD8749/11: the buying decision

segments.source: Naviglio Deluxe adds tube-fed frothing to an automatic coffee platform with front access and physical controls. The HD8749/11 can therefore interest someone who wants milk foam without operating a steam wand or buying a more elaborate screen-based machine. Three Optiaroma strengths and a five-position ceramic grinder keep customization limited and understandable. The removable cappuccinatore must be rinsed promptly, so automatic foam still leaves a cleaning task. This is the 230 V Deluxe with the milk tube, not the base pannarello Naviglio or the separate Capp-in-Cup model. Those distinctions matter when comparing apparently similar low-priced listings.
